name: beacon_proxy
description: Uninitialized beacon/proxy implementation contract due to missing _disableInitializers()
question: The source file in `source` defines an upgradeable implementation contract that uses an Initializable base and exposes an external `initialize` function (guarded by an `initializer` modifier), intended to be deployed behind a BeaconProxy/UpgradeableBeacon, but its constructor does not call `_disableInitializers()`, so anyone can call `initialize` directly on the implementation contract to seize ownership or corrupt its storage before it is ever proxied.
criteria: Contract inherits/imports Initializable and declares an `initialize(...)` function with the `initializer` modifier
Contract is clearly meant for beacon/proxy deployment (e.g. implements an IVault-style interface used by BeaconProxy/UpgradeableBeacon)
Constructor is empty or otherwise does not call `_disableInitializers()`
No alternate safeguard exists preventing direct external initialization of the implementation contract itself
